title: Xanthe and the Tryouts
author: Zephyrine Villalobos
blurb: Zephyrine Oyelaran, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide who to be when the labels come off before the final audition.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
